topic: Types and Architectures of AI Agents

asset_1.asset_suggestion: A software product interface representing an industrial energy monitoring dashboard shell. Its structure contains a multi-pane layout composed of a top utility header bar, a central telemetry workspace displaying site performance metric regions, a right-hand sidebar dedicated to operational anomaly alerts, and a bottom status container housing data query panels. The individual layout frames, navigation regions, and data viewport containers exist as distinct, modular structural zones that allow independent control and recomposition across different site monitoring contexts.
asset_1.construction_paragraph: The `EnergyMonitoringDashboard` is designed as a heavy-duty industrial telemetry interface shell constructed as a unified `VGroup`, organizing real-time power grid performance data into a modular multi-pane console layout. Grounding the asset is a dark slate-gray metallic chassis backplate rendered via a low-opacity `RoundedRectangle` layered over a slightly offset black drop shadow, surrounded by an outer dark alloy bezel frame with subtle inner edge highlight strokes and geometric corner accent brackets for visual elevation. The primary structure partitions the screen plane into four distinct structural zones using relative alignment: a full-width top utility header container, a prominent central telemetry workspace pane occupying the main screen area, a vertical right-hand operational anomaly sidebar, and a wide bottom data query status panel. Within the secondary structure, the top header bar features a left-aligned site title block ("PLANT 09 - PRIMARY GRID"), central system operational status text with glowing circular LED indicators, and a right-aligned live timestamp ("14:32:08 UTC"); the central telemetry workspace breaks down into an upper telemetry line-graph viewport with coordinate axes and background grid lines, alongside a lower dual metric gauge cluster; the right sidebar houses stacked alert card sub-panels with high-contrast warning headers ("HIGH VOLTAGE - TR-402", "INVERTER TRIP"); and the bottom query container presents a multi-column terminal layout with structured data logs ("QUERY: STABILITY_INDEX = 99.4%") and filter status controls. Visual richness is established in the detail layer using double-resolution crisp metric typography ("847.2 kW", "60.02 Hz"), fine dashed horizontal gridlines, status LEDs with semi-transparent outer halo rings (`AnnularSector`), thin metallic section dividers, and structural corner crosshairs on each sub-pane. All components are assembled in a rigorous `VGroup` hierarchy—`self.header`, `self.telemetry_pane`, `self.sidebar`, and `self.query_panel`—ensuring distinct functional boundaries. The asset exposes these major regions via public attributes and dedicated getters such as `get_telemetry_viewport()` and `get_alert_cards()`, enabling external scenes to dynamically drive metric values, swap chart paths, or toggle alert states while preserving the dashboard's underlying structural framing.

asset_2.asset_suggestion: A structured enterprise diagnostic report document interface representing the output choices of the utility-based agent. Its structure is non-trivial because it relies on a standardized UI document hierarchy containing distinct modular regions that require consistent spacing, alignment, and internal visual organization. The composition consists of a top header banner with document metadata, a status badge container, a structured data grid displaying site metrics, a side-by-side content block for system diagnostics versus summary text, and a bottom section dedicated to recommendation confidence indicators. The individual content blocks, header tags, and metric cards can be independently replaced, restyled, or reconfigured to represent different report types such as detailed diagnostics or brief executive summaries. This document asset sits alongside the decision node in the workflow, acting as the structured payload produced by the agent's utility evaluation.

The primary structure is vertically organized into four distinct functional regions: an aligned top header banner, an operational metrics grid, a split dual-panel section for system diagnostics and executive summaries, and a bottom recommendation confidence panel. The top header banner features a dark contrasting rectangular strip aligned to the upper interior canvas edge, displaying high-resolution bold document metadata ("DIAGNOSTIC REPORT // UTILITY_EVAL_v4.2") alongside a right-aligned status badge constructed as an emerald-tinted pill box (`RoundedRectangle`) containing a vivid status label ("STATUS: OPTIMAL // PASSED"). asset_3.asset_suggestion: A specialized AI agent simulation software dashboard shell representing an interactive testing environment. Its structure is non-trivial due to a structured desktop application layout composed of a top application bar with window controls, a collapsible left navigation panel for agent configuration selection, a central execution canvas region, and a bottom diagnostic telemetry console. The top header, left sidebar navigation, main viewport area, and console panel exist as discrete layout sections that can be independently updated, recolored, or recomposed to simulate an active developer environment. It acts as the primary frame framing the architectural components and decision loop visualizations.
asset_3.construction_paragraph: The `AgentDashboardShell` asset is an interactive AI simulation application window designed as a modular desktop interface composed of an outer chassis, top utility header, left configuration panel, central execution canvas, and bottom diagnostic telemetry console. The foundation layer begins with an offset shadow surface constructed from a translucent dark `RoundedRectangle`, overlaid by the main application background frame—a high-density dark slate `RoundedRectangle` with a fine accent stroke establishing the crisp outer window rim. The primary structure partitions the interior volume into distinct layout zones using relative spatial alignment: a thin horizontal header bar anchored along the upper inner rim, a vertical navigation sidebar positioned beneath the header extending down the left edge, a wide central execution canvas occupying the top-right viewport region, and a bottom diagnostic console situated directly below the canvas. The secondary structure adds functional subcomponents, featuring a standard window control set (red, yellow, and green circular dot primitives) aligned to the top-left of the header alongside a crisp monospace title ("AGENT_STUDIO_PRO v2.4") and an illuminated status pill ("ENV: RUNNING"), a stacked set of agent selection cards ("LLM_REASONER", "POLICY_NET", "EPISODIC_MEMORY") within the sidebar complete with a highlighted selection overlay box, an inner grid-lined viewport frame for the central canvas with an embedded header bar ("GRAPH_VIEW // RUN_04"), and tabbed console panels ("TELEMETRY", "LOGS", "METRICS") above diagnostic output lines in the bottom section. The detail layer introduces visual realistic depth using ultra-thin `Line` primitives as panel seam dividers, inset shadow borders around the main viewport, mini LED status indicators, dynamic scrollbar tracks, and precise telemetry text strings ("LATENCY: 14ms", "TICK_RATE: 60Hz"). Semantically, the architecture is structured into a clean `VGroup` hierarchy encompassing `header_bar`, `nav_sidebar`, `execution_canvas`, and `telemetry_console` bound to the parent `AgentDashboardShell` container, enabling direct public key access (`shell.header`, `shell.sidebar`, `shell.canvas`, `shell.console`) and getter methods (`get_subcomponent()`) for independent recoloring, panel swapping, or structural manipulation without breaking the structural layout integrity.
